name: What are my options if a window lock cannot be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What are my options if a window lock cannot be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a window lock is severely damaged or obsolete, making repair impractical, we will discuss replacement options with you. This might involve replacing just the locking mechanism with a compatible new part or, in some cases, recommending a full window replacement if the window frame itself is compromised. We will provide clear recommendations and transparent pricing for all viable solutions to restore your window's security.
acceptedAnswer.description: If repair isn't possible, options include replacing the locking mechanism or, if the frame is compromised, a full window replacement.
